notes.title: Version 1.7 released: The "Red Button" update
notes.notes:
We've been working hard making some serious performance boost. Everything is now sorted out and now we can resume adding some new cool stuff and awesome features.

Apart from the performance we've added some other enjoyable things:

[list]
    [*]Track button: link its action to other piece action, press the button, and let the magic begin.
    [*]Train crash: TrainerVR is now face to face train crash frustation-free.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Trainer v1.5 Major update
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 is here! This update includes lots of new fun features and a new build-from-the-ground train physics (no more frustrating no-crash situations, lol)

Version new features:
- Remodeled Train Physics (Frustration-Free)
- TNT (hours of fun guaranteed)
- New Menu categories
- Lots of new stuff: downtown modular buildings, track pieces, huge mountains, animals.
- New controller models (wrecking ball enabled!)
- Arc teleport
- Character animations
- Performance improvements
- And probably more things we don't remember right now

notes.title: New version TrainerVR 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
This version is awesome, check the new features:

- New snap system. Tracks will never move again and you will be able to create distant towns and join them. The new snap system works great!
- Thumbsitck control movement for HTC.
- Added another decoration menu full of new and cool items
- Added cargo items to load on trains
- Added cointainers 
- Added safe construction mode

Enjoy!
